note: Quality thresholds for tuna-os/mariner. Thresholds are declared here and reviewed on a cadence (human-in-the-loop tuning); automated enforcement beyond the required CI gates is future work.

typecheck.via: Publish Flatpak workflow, mariner module (npm run typecheck)

tuning.cadence: quarterly, or when a gate fails spuriously twice
rules: Raise line_floor_percent toward 100 as suites grow; never lower it to make CI pass.
A coverage drop below the floor blocks on investigation, not on the number alone — check whether the new code is genuinely untestable headless first.
